notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.02
notes.notes:
Some very quick post launch hotfixes in today's update:
[list]
[*] Bugfix on Leaderboard text wraps for long usernames
[*] Notes added in Caravan on how to save your highscore for leaderboards
[*] Bugfix on enemy music loop when changing maps or games
[/list]

A big shout out to everyone that's already grabbed a copy on launch day! Thanks!🐐🐑
